faqs.q: What is the National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026?
faqs.a: From the first full pay period on or after 1 July 2026, the National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for a 38-hour week. Casual employees receive an additional 25% loading, making it $33.05 per hour. Award minimum wages also increased by 4.75% from the same date, as confirmed by the Fair Work Ombudsman.

Casual loading is an extra 25% paid on top of the base hourly rate to compensate for not receiving paid leave entitlements like annual leave and sick leave. For example, if the base rate is $26.44, the casual rate becomes $33.05. When using the timesheet, you enter the base rate and check the casual loading box; do not enter a rate that already includes loading.

faqs.q: What is the super guarantee rate and how is it paid?
faqs.a: The super guarantee is 12% of your ordinary earnings, paid on top of your salary or wages by your employer. It applies up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. For an employee earning the National Minimum Wage, super adds about $5,480 per year on top of the annual salary.

bodyMarkdown:
## From Hourly to Annual: Understanding Your Pay

Whether you're negotiating a salary, comparing job offers, or just curious about your annual worth, converting an hourly rate to a yearly figure is straightforward. The basic formula is **hourly rate × hours per week × 52 weeks. This article assumes a standard full-time week of 38 hours, as defined by the Fair Work Ombudsman for the National Minimum Wage. We'll walk through the National Minimum Wage, award rates, casual loading, superannuation, and tax, and even touch on how a retired prime minister salary Australia compares.

### The National Minimum Wage vs Award Rates

From 1 July 2026, the National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. This is the legal floor for employees not covered by an award or agreement. Most employees, however, are covered by an award that sets higher minimum rates for their industry and role. Award minimum wages also increased by 4.75% from 1 July 2026. For example, the Children’s Services Award and Pharmacy Award have additional increases due to gender-based undervaluation reviews. You can find the exact rates for your award in the [pay guides](/blog) provided by the Fair Work Ombudsman.

### Casual Loading

Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the base hourly rate to compensate for not receiving paid leave. For the National Minimum Wage, the casual rate is $33.05 per hour. When using the [timesheet](/), you enter the base rate and check the casual loading box—never enter a rate that already includes loading.

### Calculating Annual Salary

Using the formula: $26.44 × 38 hours × 52 weeks = $52,269.44 per year (before tax and super). For a casual at $33.05: $33.05 × 38 × 52 = $65,346.80. The fortnightly pay is simply weekly pay × 2: for the minimum wage, $1,004.90 × 2 = $2,009.80 before tax.

### Superannuation

Super is paid on top of your salary at 12% of ordinary earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. For the National Minimum Wage, super adds about $6,272 per year. This is not deducted from your pay; it's an additional contribution by your employer.

### Tax and Medicare

Using the 2026–27 resident tax rates: tax-free threshold up to $18,200, then 15% to $45,000, 30% to $135,000, 37% to $190,000, and 45% above. Medicare levy is generally 2%. For a full-time minimum wage earner ($52,269), tax would be approximately $7,267 plus $1,045 Medicare, leaving about $43,957 take-home. Use the [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) calculator for a personalised estimate.

### A Note on the Retired Prime Minister Salary Australia

While most workers rely on the National Minimum Wage or award rates, a retired prime minister salary Australia is set by the Remuneration Tribunal. The Remuneration Tribunal determines the base salary for parliamentarians, including former prime ministers after retirement. As of 2026, the base salary for a parliamentarian is determined by the Remuneration Tribunal (Members of Parliament) Determination. This is a separate system from the National Minimum Wage, but it illustrates how different pay structures exist for different roles. For the vast majority of employees, the Fair Work Ombudsman's [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) and award rates apply.

### Important Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
